mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET cash = cash - #{amount} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE accounts SET cash = cash + #{amount} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.symbol, o.name AS name, p.quantity, COALESCE(o.avg_price, 0) AS averagePrice, 0 AS currentPrice FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT symbol, name, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'BUY' THEN price * quantity ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'BUY' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS avg_price FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY symbol ) o ON p.symbol = o.symbol WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.quantity > 0
